title: Eighth Millennium Pottery from a Prehistoric Shell Midden in the Brazilian Amazon
lineage: Excavation, dating, and environmental analyses of the same mound. AMS carbon fractions and thermoluminescence come from the same sherd, while other dates come from charcoal and shell.

passages.note: Excavation Test 1. Reduced carbon from a level 12-base sherd, OxA-2431, dated to 7600–7280 cal BP at 95% confidence in the paper. The humic fraction is OxA-2432 and a separate fragment of that sherd supplied the TL estimate.

The sherds are described as fragile, red-brown and grit-tempered. The authors discuss mobile humic acids and modern carbon as possible contaminants and report a broad error for the single TL assay. Riverine faunal remains contextualize the assemblage.
